assumptions.assumption: Greenfield: the target dir contains only walteur-kit/run-trace.jsonl (WALTEUR engine scaffold), no existing URL-shortener code, so no code to preserve
shortUrl is constructed from a base URL derived from the incoming request Host header (fallback e.g. http://localhost:PORT) since no fixed public domain was specified
Short codes are short alphanumeric strings (e.g. 6-7 chars from a URL-safe alphabet via node:crypto), collision-safe by regenerate-on-collision

'Typed errors' means structured JSON error objects with a stable type/code field plus message, not custom JS Error classes exposed over the wire (though internal Error subclasses are a fine implementation)
Validation rejects: missing body, non-JSON body, missing/non-string url, and URLs whose scheme is not http or https; all return 400 with a typed error (unknown code on GET returns 404)
POST /shorten returns 201 (or 200) with {code, shortUrl}; GET /:code returns 302 with Location; malformed routes/methods return typed 404/405
In-memory store resets on process restart (acceptable per in-memory requirement)
Server exposes a factory (createServer/app) importable by tests so the suite can start it on an ephemeral port (port 0) and drive it over real HTTP
Node 18+ is available (node:test is stable there); ESM modules used throughout
No URL de-duplication required — each POST mints a new code unless de-dup is trivially free
